description: This file implements the egl::Surface class and related surface classes for the ANGLE project, handling creation, management, and operations of rendering surfaces such as window, pbuffer, and pixmap surfaces.

classes.name: SurfaceState
classes.description: Holds state information for a surface, including configuration and attributes.

classes.name: Surface
classes.description: Represents a rendering surface, managing its lifecycle, configuration, and operations like swap, bind, and release.

classes.name: WindowSurface
classes.description: Surface implementation for native window surfaces.

classes.name: PbufferSurface
classes.description: Surface implementation for pixel buffer surfaces.

classes.name: PixmapSurface
classes.description: Surface implementation for native pixmap surfaces.

classes.name: SurfaceDeleter
classes.description: Functor for safely deleting Surface objects.

methods.name: destroyImpl
methods.description: Destroys the surface implementation and cleans up resources.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the surface with the display, setting up implementation details.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes the surface current in the given context.

methods.name: unMakeCurrent
methods.description: Releases the surface from being current.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the front and back buffers.

methods.name: bindTexImage
methods.description: Binds a texture to the surface.

methods.name: releaseTexImage
methods.description: Releases the texture bound to the surface.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets a label for the surface.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the label of the surface.
